source_snapshot.procedure: Open BMC Web GPU management > Event Logs and GET the Wistron OEM GPU EventLog Entries collection with credentials embedded in the URL.
source_snapshot.criteria: GPU has no warning or critical event.
source_snapshot.script: No Script; Config-Check; 5/5 minutes; unique code/variant.
source_snapshot.deepseek: YES but substitutes host nvidia-smi ECC/NVSM telemetry over insecure SSH and never reads the BMC Web/OEM Redfish event collection.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION/HIGH; restores protected paginated OEM Redfish plus Web evidence and severity/time/GPU mapping.

old_problem: Credentials are placed in the Redfish URL; OEM schema, pagination, GPU identity, time window/timezone, warning/critical normalization and active/cleared/acknowledged semantics are undefined. DeepSeek replaces the required BMC event log with host telemetry, so it cannot prove the source criterion.
disposition_reason: The read-only test is technically complete once the OEM endpoint/schema and severity/time mapping are supplied as Project Configuration. ED-08 and the Web/KVM visual-evidence rule retain an actual Web capture; ED-17 forbids clearing before evidence. Standard Redfish collection pagination and secure session/header authentication replace URL credentials. Host telemetry may correlate but cannot substitute.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2046, same-row DeepSeek, GPT V2, historical record, unique-code result and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; actual next row Functionality 2047 / Wistron-AMD SVM-00141-V005 / ca1686ccc73c4a90 was directly read from XLSX.
The source explicitly names the OEM BMC GPU EventLog collection and Web page, so nvidia-smi/NVSM data is supplemental and cannot replace either surface.
A collection must follow every pagination link and preserve raw entries; an empty first page or filtered Web view is not complete evidence.
GPU, severity and timestamp fields require the signed OEM schema plus a normalized warning/critical and active/cleared policy; no universal OEM semantics are guessed.
Credentials must use protected session/header injection with trusted TLS/hostname validation and redacted artifacts, never URL userinfo.
No BMC/Web/Redfish/host login, event read/acknowledge/delete/clear, GPU query or DUT action was performed.

test_case.test_name: Secure OEM GPU EventLog pagination and BMC Web parity
test_case.purpose: Collect every OEM BMC GPU EventLog entry through secure read-only Redfish, reconcile it to the actual GPU management > Event Logs Web view, and verify no in-scope GPU has an owner-defined active warning or critical event.
required_package: Exact row-2046 variant plus SUT/BMC/GPU identities and firmware inventory
Approved OEM endpoint/schema, collection pagination contract, GPU field/alias map and Web field/filter map
Signed severity/state normalization for warning, critical, active, cleared and acknowledged plus time window/timezone/retention/dedup rules
Protected read-only Redfish/Web account, trusted TLS/hostname configuration and secret-redaction method
Human visual Web reviewer and event disposition/verdict owner
test_case.test_command: STRICTLY READ-ONLY; verify BMC/GPU identities and preserve existing event state. Authenticate with a protected Redfish session/header over validated TLS; never put credentials in the URL. GET the exact approved OEM Entries URI, retain status/headers/raw body and follow every next/pagination link until the collection count is reconciled. Normalize entries by OEM event identity, GPU map, timestamp/timezone, severity and state without deleting/acknowledging. A human captures the real BMC Web GPU Event Logs page, all required pages/filters and visual context; compare Web and API entry sets. Host nvidia-smi/NVSM may be supplemental only. No clear or automatic retry.
test_case.expected_result: The complete deduplicated OEM collection and all Web pages map consistently to the approved GPU inventory and time window, with no active owner-defined warning or critical entry; cleared/acknowledged/history entries are handled exactly by the signed policy and no hidden page/filter disagreement exists.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires complete pagination/count reconciliation, valid GPU/severity/time/state mapping, actual Web visual evidence and no in-scope active warning/critical event. FAIL on such an event, unknown severity/state, missing/extra/duplicate page entry, GPU/time ambiguity, incomplete pagination or API/Web disagreement. Missing schema/policy/access is NOT READY; host-only data cannot PASS.
safety_gate: Read-only GET/Web access only; never clear, delete, acknowledge or mutate an event.
Use protected session/header credentials, TLS and hostname validation; redact secrets from commands and artifacts.
Preserve raw pages and first observed state before normalization; do not hide entries with filters.
Stop on warning/critical event, incomplete pagination, identity ambiguity or API/Web disagreement; no automatic retry.
expected_evidence: Exact Source Key/Variant/hash plus SUT/BMC/GPU/firmware identity
Approved OEM schema, endpoint, pagination and GPU/severity/time/state policy
Redacted request metadata, HTTP outcomes and all raw paginated responses with hashes/timestamps
Actual Web visual captures including filters/page context and every relevant entry
API-Web entry-set, GPU, severity/state and time-window reconciliation plus host telemetry marked supplemental
test_case.recovery: On access/TLS failure, incomplete pagination, warning/critical event or API-Web mismatch, stop read-only collection and preserve raw pages/screenshots plus timestamps. Close sessions and rotate exposed credentials. Do not clear, acknowledge, filter away or retry to change the state; escalate exact event/GPU/page identity.

source_conflict.reason: Secure paginated OEM Redfish plus mandatory Web parity restores the named evidence; signed OEM normalization closes schema gaps and host telemetry is explicitly supplemental.

blocked.reason: Read-only collection, verdict and recovery are complete; OEM schema, maps and credentials are supplyable runtime Project Configuration.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: OEM endpoint/schema/pagination, GPU/Web field map, severity/state/time-window policy, protected access and human Web/verdict ownership.
pending.execution_status: REVIEW RESOLVED TO SECURE PAGINATED OEM GPU EVENTLOG/WEB PARITY; NO LOGIN, EVENT READ/MUTATION, GPU QUERY OR DUT ACTION EXECUTED
